title: SecOps-NG Posture Evidence Artifact (SKELETON stub)
description: Typed shape for one evidence artifact emitted by the infrastructure-posture-management evidence stream — the continuous variant of the F-WF-02 posture-audit lane. One artifact is produced per scheduled execution of `playbook.infra_posture_management@v1` and pins, mechanically, (a) the posture-state snapshot the workflow collected over the operator's in-scope infrastructure manifest and (b) the per-control evaluation result set the workflow derived against that snapshot under the policy version in force at evaluation time. Downstream consumer is the NIS2 Article 21(2)(a) risk-analysis / information-system-security-policies mapping. SKELETON: the required-field shape is pinned at this layer so the CORE-FANOUT sibling cards can bind primitive emitters against a stable contract; the nested object shapes (`posture_state` value structure, `control_evaluation` deviation list) are intentionally permissive at the SKELETON layer and tightened in the EXTEND-schema sibling card once the per-target emitters have been worked through. Public-bar artifact: operator-side strings (resource ids, policy versions, owner labels) MUST stay role-shaped or opaque; individual personal names, credential-shaped strings, and raw cloud-account secret material are out of scope per AGENTS.md §3 and rejected at the schema boundary.

schema_version.description: Pinned schema version. Lets a consumer reject artifacts produced under an older schema once breaking changes ship.

artifact_id.description: Stable per-artifact identifier. Convention: SHA-256 hex digest of `<workflow_id>|<execution_id>|<compile_target>|<policy_version.value>` (UTF-8, no separators around the pipes). Deterministic on those four inputs so a replay of the same execution under the same compile target and the same policy version re-derives the same id; re-emissions inside the same execution stay byte-identical at the path level.

stream.description: Identifies which evidence stream produced the artifact. Constant on this schema.

workflow_id.description: Stable identifier of the workflow whose execution this artifact covers. Convention: lower-snake-case workflow stable-id from `content/playbooks/<workflow>/` — for posture-management artifacts this is `infra_posture_management`. Joins back into the workflow content layer so a reviewer can re-derive which playbook was compiled into the running form.

execution_id.description: Per-execution identifier issued by the compile target's workflow runtime (n8n execution id, Temporal workflow run id, LangGraph thread/checkpoint id). Each scheduled re-execution emits its own posture artifact — re-runs of the same workflow produce distinct execution_ids and distinct artifact_ids.

compile_target.description: Which of the three reference compile targets produced the running form of the workflow. The artifact is target-specific because the posture-collection surface differs per target. Constrained to the three reference targets the project ships compilers for.

regulation_refs.description: Pins to the upstream regulatory mapping entries this artifact helps satisfy (typically `nis2:art-21-2-a`). At least one entry — an artifact with no regulatory anchor is not evidence in the posture-stream sense. Joins back into content/mappings/<regime>/*.yaml via the `id` field.

control_refs.description: Control stable-ids attested by this artifact. At least one — typically `control.cspm_baseline@v1`, `control.risk_management_policy@v1`, or `control.asset_inventory_delta@v1`.

policy_version.description: The version of the operator's posture policy that was in force when the controls were evaluated against the collected posture state. Pairs the evaluation with the policy text a reviewer can re-derive. Role-shaped: SemVer or content-hash; arbitrary free text rejected.

scheme.description: How `value` is interpreted. `semver` for a SemVer string published with the policy document; `content_hash` for a SHA-256 hex digest of the policy bytes as fetched.

value.description: The actual version token. SemVer string for `semver`; 64-char lower-hex SHA-256 for `content_hash`.

posture_state.description: Pointer to or summary of the posture-state snapshot the workflow collected against the operator's in-scope infrastructure manifest. SKELETON: the inner shape is intentionally permissive — the CORE-FANOUT sibling cards bind the per-target collection primitive and the EXTEND-schema sibling card tightens the inner object shape. Required keys at this layer: a `scope_ref` opaque pointer back to the operator's manifest, a `resource_count` non-negative integer, and a `snapshot_hash` content hash of the collected snapshot bytes for replay re-derivation.

scope_ref.description: Opaque pointer back to the operator's in-scope infrastructure manifest. Operator-side string; the framework does not interpret it.

resource_count.description: Number of distinct resources the workflow walked under the declared scope.

snapshot_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the collected snapshot bytes. Anchors replay re-derivation.

control_evaluation.description: Per-control evaluation result set the workflow derived against the snapshot under the declared policy_version. SKELETON: at least one entry; the inner shape is intentionally permissive at this layer — the EXTEND-schema sibling card tightens the deviation list and pins the attestation_state vocabulary against `schemas/attestation_state.json`. Required per-entry keys at this layer: a `control_ref` to the control evaluated, an `attestation_state` token, and a non-negative `deviation_count` so reviewer-side rollups can read the artifact without re-walking the deviation list.

attestation_state.description: Attestation outcome for this control against the snapshot. SKELETON enum mirrors the F-CP-01 risk-analysis vocabulary; tightened against schemas/attestation_state.json in the EXTEND-schema sibling card.

deviation_count.description: Number of distinct resources whose collected configuration deviated from the policy baseline for this control. Zero for `effective`.

evaluated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which the per-control evaluation was performed against the posture snapshot. Distinct from `captured_at` for the upstream `collect-posture` step.

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which the posture-state snapshot was collected. Carried alongside `evaluated_at` so a reviewer can see both ends of the per-execution window.

provenance.description: Where this artifact came from. Mirrors the provenance pattern used by content/controls/*.yaml so a reviewer can re-derive the chain back to source.

source_url.description: URL of the workflow run (or workflow-content source) that produced this artifact.

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 date or date-time matching the artifact-level captured_at.

commit_sha.description: Optional commit SHA of the content snapshot the workflow walked.

owner.description: Optional dated ownership pointer for the posture posture the artifact covers. Role-shaped — a working-group mailbox, a generic role title, or a community handle. Individual personal names are out of scope per AGENTS.md §3.

retention.description: Optional retention pointer the operator declares for this evidentiary record. ISO-8601 duration.
